items.item_text: Specific building maintenance duties: operate, maintain, inspect, troubleshoot and repair all hospital buildings and related equipment and systems, including but not limited to: -HVAC and Refrigeration, -mechanical and plumbing equipment and distribution systems, including hot/cold water, storm water, sanitary waste, steam, condensate, fire sprinkler, etc., electrical systems, including normal power, emergency power (generator, ATS, UST), -BAS (building automation system), including electric and pneumatic controls, -pneumatic tube system, -Elevators, -TV distribution, -Medical Gas equipment and distribution, -nurse call system, -low voltage systems, including communication systems, PA , access control, -patient beds, gurneys, -kitchen equipment, -Life Safety equipment and systems, -corrective and preventive work order system, general maintenance, including drywall repair, patch & paint, basic carpentry, key and lock, etc., -all related auxiliary equipment for systems listed above

Specific Central Plant duties: Operate, maintain, inspect, troubleshoot and repair all central plant/assigned building spaces and related equipment/ systems including but not limited to: -pressure vessel and related auxiliary equipment, HVAC and Refrigeration, including chillers, cooling towers, -mechanical and plumbing equipment and distribution systems, including, hot/cold water (heat exchangers, water heaters, etc.), storm water, sanitary waste, steam, condensate, fire sprinkler, etc., -electrical systems including emergency generator and ATS and related auxiliary equipment, -Medical Gas equipment and distribution, including air compressors and vacuum pumps and related auxiliary equipment, -water softener and chemical treatment systems, -BAS (building automation system), including electric and pneumatic controls, -Life Safety equipment and systems (FA Alarm panel, etc.), -nurse call system, -corrective and preventive work order system, -hot and cold water systems and distribution, -UST, -pneumatic tube system, -all related auxiliary equipment for systems listed above
Continuously monitor all pressure vessel operations, gauges, valves, and visible audible controls (per Title 8)
Assist preparing the boiler for annual inspection, source testing, etc.
Perform water treatment activities to ensure established chemical water balances are constantly maintained
Complete all scheduled and unscheduled preventive maintenance tasks as assigned
